Large paper panel spans x280..1770,y65..1010 on 1920x1080; LEFT outside paper edge x110..330 has five horizontal worn navy PAPER BOOKMARK TABS vertically stacked, protruding from left like the notebook navigation. "글자 크기" with segmented values "100%" "125%" "150%" "200%", 125% visibly selected.
"단서 표시" with selector "색상 + 문양 + 이름" and small chevrons.
"화면 움직임" with segmented "기본" "줄이기" "끄기", 줄이기 selected.
"감각 자막" with two explicit choices "켜기" "끄기", 켜기 selected.

Bottom left small text button "기본값", bottom right "뒤로" text and wide dark navy ornate paper button "적용". Align baselines; footer safely inside blank paper. Use same button and border language as reference. No character, no slot thumbnails, no date, no percentage progress bar, no extra settings or helper labels. All content fits without scrolling. Fine ornament only at edges; high contrast.
